android.desc:
Algomaya is the only free app that combines paper trading, algo trading bots, and AI coaching — all in one platform. Practice stock trading on NSE, BSE, NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX and F&O with virtual money. Build automated algo bots without coding. Backtest strategies on real historical data. The best free trading app in India.

WHY 1,600+ TRADERS CHOSE ALGOMAYA

Most paper trading apps stop at virtual trading. Algomaya goes further — it is the first app to put a stock trading simulator, no-code algo bot builder, backtesting engine, and AI trading assistant together in a single free app. Whether you want to learn stock market basics or automate advanced algo strategies, Algomaya has you covered.

PAPER TRADING SIMULATOR — NSE, BSE & MORE
Practice stock trading and crypto trading with virtual cash. Execute buy and sell orders on real market data from NSE, BSE, NIFTY 50, BANKNIFTY, and global markets. Track your virtual portfolio with detailed P&L analytics. The safest way to learn share market trading before risking real money.

NO-CODE ALGO TRADING BOT BUILDER
Build automated trading bots using a visual strategy builder — no other free app offers this. Choose from 15+ technical indicators including RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, EMA, Supertrend, and more. No programming required. Deploy your algo trading strategies and watch them execute automatically on market data.

BACKTEST STRATEGIES ON REAL DATA
Test your trading strategies against years of real historical market data before going live. See exactly how your strategy would have performed. Compare results across different stocks, options, and crypto assets. Multi-asset portfolio testing included.

50+ READY-MADE TRADING STRATEGIES
Not sure where to start? Choose from 50+ pre-built algo trading strategies created by experts — the largest free strategy library in any stock market simulator. Learn how each strategy works, then customize it to match your trading style.

AI TRADING ASSISTANT — MAYA
Maya, your 24/7 AI assistant and trading coach, answers questions about stock trading, explains technical indicators, and helps you build better algo strategies. Get personalized guidance on share market analysis, options, and crypto markets.

LEARN ALGO TRADING FOR FREE
Access 11+ free trading courses on algorithmic trading, technical analysis, and trading psychology. 30+ step-by-step tutorials for trading education — from candlestick patterns to machine learning. Daily quizzes with streak rewar
